title: Index computational models of Pāṇini (vidyut, the Sanskrit Heritage Platform and others)
summary: A per-sutra index to computational models of Pāṇini (vidyut, the Sanskrit Heritage Platform and others): where it treats each sutra, and a summary in our own words of what it says. The work's own text is never copied.

inputs.what: computational models of Pāṇini (vidyut, the Sanskrit Heritage Platform and others)

licence: Our own index and summaries (CC-BY-SA-4.0); the work is cited, never reproduced.
how: Record the work's full citation in a source with a 'citation' field.
One row per place the work treats a sutra: id, locator (volume and page), a summary of at most 400 characters.
